question: After rejecting one answer-signed point, is the exact weight-folded response tensor organized by a discrete construction/direction hierarchy, a coupled six-cell table, or neither?
evidence_status: CPU-only held-out restricted-tensor structure screen; no causal selector, circuit repair, or adoption claim.

prior_art_and_novelty.known_lessons: Variance preservation and in-sample PCA/SAE are not circuit identification. Donor-answer sign is confounded with transfer direction and failed held-out prediction.
prior_art_and_novelty.novelty: Fit five explicit computational state models on reporter-disjoint rows of the weight-folded Q tensor and compare their held-out predictions: global, direction, panel, additive panel+direction, and coupled panel-by-direction.

method.direction_index: group_number parity, checked against every authority row's direction and answer-change fields
method.reporter_folds: groups modulo 4 in {0,1} fit and {2,3} test, then reverse; both sides contain four rows per panel-by-direction cell

models.panel: one fit mean per A1/A2/P panel
models.cell: one fit mean per panel-by-direction cell

predictions.pred_a_authority_identity_balanced_folds: Hashes, shape, row IDs, categorical labels, four fit/test rows per cell, formulas, finiteness, and operation counts match.
predictions.pred_b_six_cell_model_predicts_heldout_r: Across both folds, cell-model pooled cosine is >=0.90, every cell mean is >=0.85, every row is >=0.70, and all row cosines are positive.
predictions.pred_c_additive_hierarchy_explains_cells: Across folds, additive pooled cosine is >=0.85, every additive cell mean is >=0.75, and the cell-minus-additive pooled advantage is <=0.05.
predictions.pred_d_cell_identities_are_crossfit_stab: The six corresponding cell prototypes across reporter folds have mean cosine >=0.90 and minimum cosine >=0.80.
predictions.pred_e_scope_is_heldout_structure_screen: No model, GPU, v21 outcome, intervention, selected factors, or causal gate is opened.

opposing_outcomes.additive_discrete_hierarchy: A-E pass: carry a panel-plus-direction restricted-tensor specification into H/R decomposition.
opposing_outcomes.coupled_six_state_tensor: A/B/D/E pass and C fails: construction and direction interact and must remain coupled.
opposing_outcomes.continuous_or_positionwise_structure: A/E pass but B or D fails: six discrete response states do not generalize; use positionwise H/R or sparse/hierarchical decomposition there.
